sasha: Quick sanity check — bringing up the quantized 8-bit build of redwood-open-7b for long-context evals and seeing what looks like KV-cache misalignment after ~32k tokens during our bench suite. Anyone seen weird token shifts or attention matrix blowups with RoPE scaling + q8?

rohit: Which quantization pipeline? llm-q8 vs our custom per-channel? and tokenizer/config used?

maria: llm-q8 (per-tensor) from the new quant run, tokenizer: hf/robin-7b-tokenizer, ctx_size=65536 for the eval harness. I can paste the failing snippet:

maria: ```python
# minimal repro loop
model = load_model('redwood-open-7b', quant='q8')
ctx = model.new_context(65536)
for i, chunk in enumerate(long_doc_chunks):
    out = model.forward(ctx, chunk)
    if i % 8 == 0:
        # inspect kv align
        check_kv_alignment(ctx.kv_cache)
```

maria: check_kv_alignment prints token index vs kv slot and we start to see repeated indices after ~32768 tokens, outputs diverge from fp16 baseline.

aj: hmmm. Could be RoPE interpolation/wrap logic. Did we enable any rope scaling heuristic (rope_scale or rope_interpolate) during quant conversion?

maria: No, we left rope params as default. fp16 baseline (same checkpoint, no quant) is fine. The divergence only shows up in q8 run.

rohit: Two likely suspects: 1) rounding noise in q8 causes small phase drift that accumulates in rotary pos enc multipliers; 2) an index truncation bug in the kv indexing path when sequence length > 2^15. Can you grep for any int16 casts in kv indexing?

maria: I inspected the code; there is a cast: `pos_ids = pos_ids.astype('int16')` in a helper we introduced last year to save memory. That could overflow at 32k. Will try changing to int32.

kv-test-bot: nightly/long-context-regression: redwood-open-7b-q8 failed at 2026-02-27T03:12Z; divergence score 0.17 vs fp16 baseline; stack snippet: `kv_index = pos_index & 0x7fff`

aj: That stack snippet looks like bitmasking for 15-bit wrap. If someone added `& 0x7fff` to emulate wrap-around, combined with int16 cast that would cause repeated indices.

sasha: Good find. So two parallel issues: (A) intentional or accidental masking (rope wrap emulation) and (B) q8 noise. Which is root?

rohit: Fix A first (int16 -> int32 and remove masking). If alignment persists, run a tiny experiment: run q8 but compute rotary factors in fp32 (dequantize weights for sin/cos multiply) and keep rest quantized. If that removes drift, it's q-noise amplification.

maria: Patch: replaced int16 cast -> int32 in kv indexing helper. Quick run: no repeated indices at 32k anymore, but we still see small token probability drift compared to fp16 at ~45k tokens.

aj: That sounds like accumulated numeric drift. Two mitigation experiments: 1) hybrid-rope: compute rotary sin/cos in fp32; 2) periodic KV refresh: every N tokens rewrite kv entries in higher precision (cheap?), or 3) add small corrective scaling factor to rope (rope_scale ~ 0.9995) to counteract multiplicative drift.

rohit: I prefer hybrid-rope as it's deterministic and isolates the sin/cos numerics. Can you benchmark throughput drop?

maria: Ran hybrid-rope: throughput -6% vs q8 baseline but drift disappears (outputs match fp16 up to 90k tokens on our test doc). So root cause = numeric accumulation in rotary multipliers under q8 arithmetic.

sasha: Nice. So plan: keep int32 fix in mainline, add hybrid-rope as an opt-in config for q-variants that target long-context. Also add a unit test: synthetic prefix of length 100k and assert kv slot monotonicity + output similarity threshold to fp16.

aj: I'll open a PR to expose `rope_compute_precision` with enum {auto, fp32, q8}. Default `auto`->fp32 when ctx>32768 or quantized model.

maria: I'll add the unit test and a microbenchmark to track perf cost. Also logging to surface "rotary_precision" in eval traces.

rohit: Also let's add a regression bench to CI (kv-test-bot help?) to run the 100k synthetic every night for q8 builds.

kv-test-bot: scheduling nightly-longctx-q8 at 05:00Z, added job id nlq8-20260227-01. Will ping if divergence > 0.05 vs fp16.

sasha: Perfect. Thanks team. Follow-ups: aj PR to expose config, maria tests + benchmark, rohit add kv-index audit, I'll draft release note blurb about q8 hybrid-rope for long-context.

maria: FYI I also spotted a weird case where rope interpolation had been enabled in a model-specific config for another checkpoint; will audit whole catalog for inconsistent rope flags.

sasha: Great catch. Thanks all :rocket:
